description: Open a URL in the recording profile (logged-in state included) and list every visible interactive element with UNIQUE selectors ranked data-testid → id → aria-label → role/text → name/placeholder → class → path, plus headings and iframes. Use it BEFORE writing targets — no selector guessing, no wasted probe. Writes logs/inspect-<n>.json and a screenshot in the demo dir. Returns a jobId immediately — poll job_status. Rejects if another job is running.

dir.description: demo project directory — pass an absolute path

frames.description: iframe selectors to scan too, as in the storyboard `frames` block

profile.description: Chrome user-data dir (default: the recording profile)

storageState.description: extra Playwright storageState JSON to seed before the scan

useSetup.description: honour the storyboard's setup block (storageState/cookies/preflight) so an authenticated page can be scanned. Default true.

name: inspect
